item.title: NASA’s SR‑1 Freedom: First Nuclear‑Powered Mars Probe
item.description: NASA’s $2 billion SR‑1 Freedom mission will launch a 20 kW nuclear reactor‑powered spacecraft to Mars by 2029, reshaping deep‑space propulsion.
